calculation.description: Ranks tradable assets by the magnitude of their recent 60-day peak-to-current drawdown, normalized by 20-day realized volatility. Larger values favor assets with deeper volatility-adjusted drawdowns, expressing contrarian recovery potential. The signal is cross-sectionally demeaned and lagged one completed trading day.
calculation.signal_reconstruction: Load close prices for the 15 tradable symbols; r=close.pct_change(); peak=close.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max(); drawdown=close/peak-1; vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); raw=-drawdown/vol; signal=raw.sub(raw.mean(axis=1),axis=0).shift(1).
